snippet.title: BattleSpinners - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
BATTLESPINNERS is a fast-paced, spinning-tops versus game. Build your spinner, launch it into the arena, and defeat your opponents by knocking them out of the ring, or by tearing them apart.
Brawl against or alongside your friends, use your skills and unleash powerful abilities to dominate the arena (1-4 players)

Demo coming November 2026

Wishlist now on steam : https://store.steampowered.com/app/4324770/BattleSpinners/

Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/nowaletyrex.bsky.social
X: https://x.com/NowaLeTyrex
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/nowa_letyrex
